_tile: M0a works one 3072 px region. The three named regions disagree with each other on purpose (BUILD, two tracks). gate is the M0a tile: the reaper, the sheaves, dense directional wheat, bare weave between them.
_scales: px at 120 px/cm. Canvas weave is ~9 px and brush-hair striation ~6 px; every smoothing scale here must sit above both or the tracer fits the cloth and the hairs.
_height: peak impasto in mm, the hand multiplier DESIGN 4.1 step 6 allows. 4 mm on an 8 mm stroke made every mark taller than it was wide.
_seeds: spacing is about a quarter of a stroke width; below that the same stroke is seeded many times and dedup does all the work.
_trace: max_arc is BUILD's hard cap, 1024 px = 8.5 cm. Direction is blended with where the trace was already going, so the tensor's own jitter at a 6 px step does not read as curvature; max_turn then measures real bend. Total turn stops at 2.6 rad because past that no single quadratic can hold it and it should be a chain.
_attrs: width from the ridge out to the shadowed gap on either side, clipped to plausible paint: 1.2 mm to 1.6 cm. colour_band is deliberately narrow -- at 0.35 the median ate the neighbouring stroke and the whole palette collapsed toward its own mean, which is BUILD's 'mud'.
_merge: a trace whose centreline is mostly inside an already-claimed, similarly-directed footprint is the same stroke found twice.
